title: CONTRIBUTING Review

requiredSignals: no workflow change required by W7-T2
no product change required by W7-T2
no product change required by W7-T2

contributionGovernanceRules: Contribution guidance identifies the repository or governance surface being changed.
Contribution guidance preserves repo ownership boundaries between ai-foundation, ai-knowledge, ai-template and root governance.
Contribution guidance states required local validation when the target repo documents it.
Knowledge contributions remain under documented knowledge structures.
Template contributions remain under documented scaffold structures.
Ambiguous legacy content is retained unless a documented migration or deprecation path exists.
Documentation review tasks do not create workflow automation or runtime behavior.
Future documentation gaps are recorded without closing future roadmap tasks.
contributorLifecycle: Classify the target surface: governance, knowledge, template or foundation.
Check existing guidance for duplicate or conflicting content.
Prepare the change within the target repo boundary.
Run validations named by the target repo when product files change.
Attach evidence to governance only when the roadmap task requires closure.
Leave future roadmap tasks unopened until explicitly selected.
